name: url_scheme
description: Complete URL protocol schemes from HTTP versus HTTPS descriptions; matched control copies a domain from the same URL-construction request.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
items=[]; control=[]
for i in range(96):
 domain=random.choice(['example.com','example.org','test.net','docs.org','demo.com','site.net']); secure=i%2==0
 protocol='HTTPS' if secure else 'HTTP'; scheme=protocol.lower(); path=random.choice(['/index','/about','/help','/docs','/api','/home'])
 desc=random.choice(['Construct a URL using {p} for host {d} and path {s}.','Give the URL for host {d}, path {s}, protocol {p}.'])
 base=desc.format(p=protocol,d=domain,s=path)+' Output only the URL.\nURL: '
 items.append({'prompt':base,'answer':scheme+'://'+domain+path})
 control.append({'prompt':base+scheme+'://','answer':domain+path})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
